name: Sanghamitra Bhanja/ ସଂଘମିତ୍ରା ଭଞ୍ଜ

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sanghamitra Bhanja writes poetry, short fiction and essays in Odia, alongside her work in teaching and literary scholarship. Associated with Rama Devi Women’s University in Bhubaneswar, she has taught modern prose and poetry and holds postgraduate qualifications in both Odia and Hindi. Her work on life writing includes translating Rama Devi’s autobiography Jeevan Pathe into Hindi as Kshitij Ke Us Paar, with assistance from Bharati Muduli, and compiling a critical volume on Rama Devi.

In ‘ଅନ୍ଧାର ଭୋଗିଚ ?’, darkness becomes a way of asking whether another person has experienced betrayal, neglect and the exhaustion of trust. The recurring question gathers force through bodily images, threatened breath and a landscape of emptiness. Its direct address makes the reader a listener to suffering rather than a distant observer.
